cover.concept: A flat mechanical valve in muted indigo line work, marked with two small flat flag shapes, mid-unscrew by a simple geometric hand silhouette in bright accent orange. Below the valve, two separate ribbon-like streams that used to run apart curve together into one shared pipe, still flowing freely now that the valve is nearly off.

inline.name: ad-copy-audit
inline.concept: A flat circular magnifying glass in bright accent orange hovering over a row of simple rectangular cards mounted on a wall in muted indigo line work. Every card looks flat and identical except one, which glows with its own distinct inner pattern, brought into sharp focus under the magnifying glass while the rest stay dull and uniform.

inline.name: landing-page-mirror
inline.concept: A simple geometric doorway in muted indigo line work where two rectangular mat shapes with different patterns meet edge to edge on the floor. A flat hand silhouette in bright accent orange smooths the seam between them so the two patterns align into one continuous mat, with a small glowing tag shape fixed to the door frame above.
